description: This file defines the main application widget for a Flutter news app, including app theming, route configuration, biometric authentication gate, and navigation setup.

classes.description: State class managing biometric authentication, app lifecycle events, and re-authentication logic.

classes.name: _BadRouteScreen
classes.description: A simple widget displaying an error when a route argument is missing or invalid.
